name: actera
description: Check Codex tool calls against Actera policies, hold calls that need approval, and report their outcomes

interface.shortDescription: Policy checks and approvals for Codex tool calls
interface.longDescription: Actera checks every tool call Codex makes against your workspace policies before it runs. Monitoring records each call; Enforcing blocks what policies deny and holds calls that need a reviewer, who can approve them in Actera or, once linked, right here in Codex. Connect with $actera-connect.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use $actera-connect to connect this Codex to Actera.
